name: Masala Chai
instructions: Boil water with ginger and cardamom.
Add tea leaves and simmer briefly.
Add milk and sugar.
Simmer until aromatic, strain and serve hot.

name: South Indian Filter Coffee
instructions: Prepare a strong coffee decoction using a South Indian filter.
Mix hot milk with the decoction.
Sweeten to taste and serve hot.

name: Poha with Peanuts
instructions: Rinse poha lightly and drain.
Temper mustard seeds, peanuts and curry leaves.
Add onion and chilli and cook until soft.
Add turmeric, poha and salt.
Cook briefly, finish with lemon juice.

name: Vegetable Upma
instructions: Dry roast semolina and keep aside.
Temper mustard seeds and curry leaves.
Saute onion and vegetables.
Add water and salt and bring to a boil.
Slowly add semolina while stirring.
Cover and cook until fluffy.

name: Aloo Paratha
instructions: Knead flour with water into a soft dough.
Mash potatoes with spices, chilli and coriander.
Fill dough portions with potato mixture and roll gently.
Cook on a hot tawa on both sides.
Apply ghee and serve with curd or pickle.

name: Moong Dal Chilla
instructions: Soak dal for 3-4 hours.
Blend with ginger, chilli, cumin, salt and enough water for a pourable batter.
Pour on a hot tawa and spread thin.
Cook both sides with a little oil.

name: Vegetable Besan Chilla
instructions: Mix gram flour with water into a smooth batter.
Fold in chopped vegetables and spices.
Spread batter on a hot tawa.
Cook until golden on both sides.

name: Masala Omelette
instructions: Whisk eggs with onion, chilli, coriander, turmeric and salt.
Heat oil in a pan.
Pour in the mixture and cook until set.
Fold and serve hot.

name: Idli
instructions: Soak rice and dal separately.
Grind to a smooth batter and ferment overnight.
Add salt and pour into greased idli moulds.
Steam until cooked.

name: Masala Dosa
instructions: Prepare and ferment dosa batter.
Make a potato masala with onion, mustard and curry leaves.
Spread batter thin on a hot tawa.
Cook until crisp, fill with potato masala and fold.

name: Vegetable Sandwich
instructions: Spread mint chutney and butter on bread.
Layer sliced vegetables and potato.
Season lightly.
Toast or serve fresh.

name: Dal Tadka
instructions: Pressure cook dal with turmeric and salt.
Saute onion, tomato and garlic.
Add cooked dal and simmer.
Temper cumin and garlic in ghee and pour over dal.

name: Moong Dal Fry
instructions: Cook dal with turmeric until soft.
Prepare a cumin, ginger and tomato tempering.
Combine with dal and simmer for a few minutes.
Adjust salt and spice.

name: Rajma Masala
instructions: Soak kidney beans overnight and pressure cook until tender.
Prepare onion, ginger, garlic and tomato masala.
Add beans and cooking liquid.
Simmer until thick and flavorful.
Finish with garam masala.

name: Chole
instructions: Soak chickpeas overnight and pressure cook.
Cook onion, ginger, garlic and tomato masala.
Add chickpeas and spice blend.
Simmer until gravy thickens.

name: Aloo Gobi
instructions: Cut potatoes and cauliflower into bite-size pieces.
Temper cumin and add vegetables.
Add spices and tomato.
Cover and cook until tender, stirring occasionally.
Finish with garam masala.

name: Bhindi Masala
instructions: Wash and completely dry okra, then slice.
Saute okra until less sticky and lightly browned.
Cook onion and tomato with spices separately.
Combine and cook until tender.
Finish with amchur.

name: Baingan Bharta
instructions: Roast eggplant until charred and soft.
Peel and mash the cooked eggplant.
Saute onion, ginger, chilli and tomato.
Add mashed eggplant and cook together.
Finish with coriander.

name: Matar Paneer
instructions: Brown paneer lightly.
Cook onion, ginger, garlic and tomato into a masala.
Add peas and water and simmer.
Add paneer and garam masala.
Simmer briefly and finish with cream if desired.

name: Palak Paneer
instructions: Blanch spinach and blend to a puree.
Saute cumin, onion, ginger and garlic.
Add tomato and cook down.
Add spinach puree and simmer.
Add paneer and garam masala and cook briefly.

name: Jeera Rice
instructions: Rinse and soak rice briefly.
Temper cumin and bay leaf in ghee.
Add rice and water with salt.
Cook until grains are fluffy and separate.

name: Vegetable Pulao
instructions: Soak rice briefly.
Saute whole spices and onion in ghee.
Add vegetables and rice.
Add water and salt and cook covered until rice is done.

name: Plain Steamed Rice
instructions: Rinse rice until water is mostly clear.
Cook with the appropriate amount of water.
Rest covered for 5 minutes and fluff.

name: Roti
instructions: Knead flour with water into a soft dough.
Rest for 15 minutes.
Divide and roll into thin rounds.
Cook on a hot tawa and finish directly over flame if desired.

name: Lachha Paratha
instructions: Make a soft dough and rest it.
Roll a portion, layer with ghee and fold into pleats.
Roll gently into a layered round.
Cook on a hot tawa with ghee until crisp and golden.

name: Cucumber Raita
instructions: Whisk yogurt.
Grate or finely chop cucumber and squeeze excess water.
Mix cucumber into yogurt.
Season with cumin and salt and garnish with coriander.

name: Green Coriander Chutney
instructions: Blend all ingredients with a splash of water.
Adjust salt and lemon.
Serve fresh.

name: Mango Pickle
instructions: Cut mango into small pieces and dry thoroughly.
Mix with salt and spices.
Warm mustard oil and cool slightly.
Combine with mango and spices.
Store in a clean dry jar and mature according to the chosen pickle method.

name: Samosa
instructions: Make a firm flour dough.
Prepare spiced potato and pea filling.
Shape dough into cones and fill.
Seal well and deep-fry on medium heat until crisp.

name: Vegetable Pakora
instructions: Slice vegetables thinly.
Mix gram flour and spices with enough water for a thick batter.
Coat vegetables.
Deep-fry spoonfuls until crisp and golden.

name: Gulab Jamun

ingredients.original: 200 g khoya or milk powder mix

instructions: Make a soft dough and form small smooth balls.
Prepare sugar syrup with cardamom.
Fry balls on low-medium heat until evenly golden.
Soak warm gulab jamun in warm syrup.
ingredients_original: 200 g khoya or milk powder mix

name: Rice Kheer
instructions: Wash and soak rice briefly.
Bring milk to a simmer.
Add rice and cook slowly, stirring often.
Add sugar and cardamom.
Finish with nuts and raisins.

name: Suji Halwa
instructions: Roast semolina in ghee until aromatic.
Add hot water carefully.
Cook while stirring until thick.
Add sugar and cardamom.
Garnish with nuts.

name: Masala Milk
instructions: Simmer milk with cardamom and saffron.
Add sugar.
Simmer until fragrant.
Serve warm with chopped nuts.

name: Lemon Rice
instructions: Temper mustard seeds, peanuts, chilli and curry leaves.
Add turmeric.
Fold in cooked rice.
Turn off heat and add lemon juice and salt.

name: Vegetable Khichdi
instructions: Rinse rice and dal.
Temper cumin in ghee.
Add vegetables, rice, dal, turmeric and water.
Pressure cook until soft.
Adjust consistency and salt.

name: Tomato Rasam
instructions: Cook and crush tomatoes.
Add tamarind, rasam powder and dal water.
Simmer gently.
Temper mustard, cumin and curry leaves and add.
Serve hot.

name: Curd Rice
instructions: Mash cooled rice lightly.
Mix with yogurt and a little milk.
Prepare tempering with mustard, urad dal, chilli and curry leaves.
Mix into rice and season with salt.

name: Carrot Beans Poriyal
instructions: Chop carrots and beans.
Temper mustard and curry leaves.
Add vegetables, chilli and salt.
Cook covered until just tender.
Finish with grated coconut.

name: Kachumber Salad
instructions: Dice vegetables.
Mix with coriander, lemon juice, salt and cumin.
Serve immediately.

name: Spine Gourd Fry (Kakrol Bhaja)
instructions: 1. (5 min) Wash the spine gourds, trim the ends and slice into thin rounds.
2. (2 min) Toss with turmeric and salt.
3. (10–12 min) Heat mustard oil and shallow-fry in batches, turning until golden and tender. Serve hot.

name: Spine Gourd Bharta (Kakrol Bhorta)
instructions: 1. (10–12 min) Steam or boil the gourds until tender, then drain well.
2. (3 min) Cool, peel if desired and mash coarsely.
3. (2 min) Mix with mustard oil, onion, green chilli, coriander and salt. Serve with rice.

name: Stuffed Spine Gourd (Bharwa Kakrol)
instructions: 1. (5 min) Scrape the gourds lightly, slit lengthwise and remove some seeds if large.
2. (3 min) Mix besan, spices, amchur and salt with a little oil.
3. (5 min) Fill each gourd with the spice mixture.
4. (15–20 min) Cover and cook in oil over low heat, turning gently until tender and browned.

name: Spine Gourd with Potatoes (Kakrol Aloo Tarkari)
instructions: 1. (5 min) Heat mustard oil and temper cumin seeds.
2. (5 min) Add onion and potato; sauté with turmeric and cumin powder.
3. (10 min) Add spine gourd, salt and water. Cover and cook until the vegetables are tender, stirring occasionally.

name: Spine Gourd Mustard Curry (Kakrol Shorshe)

ingredients.original: 300 g spine gourd, halved or sliced

instructions: 1. (5 min) Soak mustard seeds briefly, then grind with green chilli and a little water into a smooth paste.
2. (3 min) Heat mustard oil and add the gourds with turmeric and salt.
3. (10–12 min) Add mustard paste and water, cover and simmer until tender and the sauce thickens.
ingredients_original: 300 g spine gourd, halved or sliced

name: Spine Gourd Besan Fry
instructions: 1. (5 min) Mix besan, rice flour, turmeric, chilli powder, ajwain and salt.
2. (2 min) Add sliced gourd and just enough water to coat each slice.
3. (10–12 min) Shallow-fry in batches until crisp and cooked through.

name: Spine Gourd Poppy Seed Curry (Kakrol Posto)
instructions: 1. (5 min) Soak poppy seeds and grind with green chilli to a paste.
2. (2 min) Heat mustard oil and temper nigella seeds.
3. (10–12 min) Add the gourd, turmeric and salt; sauté briefly. Stir in poppy paste and water, cover and cook until tender.

name: Spine Gourd and Onion Stir-Fry
instructions: 1. (2 min) Heat oil and temper cumin seeds.
2. (3 min) Add onion and green chilli and sauté until softened.
3. (8–10 min) Add spine gourd, turmeric and salt; stir-fry until tender with lightly browned edges.

name: Crispy Spine Gourd Chips
instructions: 1. (3 min) Pat the sliced gourds dry and toss with turmeric, chilli powder and salt.
2. (2 min) Dust lightly with rice flour.
3. (8–12 min) Deep-fry in small batches until crisp, then drain on a rack or paper towel.

name: Pointed Gourd Fry (Potol Bhaja)
instructions: Wash and slit the pointed gourds lengthwise; remove seeds if desired.
Rub with turmeric and salt and rest for 10 minutes.
Heat mustard oil and shallow-fry the gourds, turning until golden and tender.

name: Pointed Gourd Bharta (Potol Bhorta)
instructions: Steam or roast pointed gourds until soft, then peel if desired.
Mash the cooked gourds with mustard oil, onion, chilli and salt.
Taste and adjust seasoning; serve with rice.

name: Pointed Gourd and Potato Curry (Aloo Potol Tarkari)

ingredients.original: 250 g pointed gourd, peeled in stripes

instructions: Rub the pointed gourds with turmeric and salt; lightly fry and set aside.
Fry potato cubes until lightly golden. Add cumin seeds, ginger and tomato.
Add powdered spices, pointed gourd and water; cover and simmer until tender.
ingredients_original: 250 g pointed gourd, peeled in stripes

name: Stuffed Pointed Gourd (Potol Dorma)
instructions: Scrape the gourds lightly, cut a slit and carefully remove the seeds.
Mix coconut, peanuts, ginger, chilli, cumin and salt; fill each gourd.
Pan-fry gently in oil, turning carefully, until cooked through. Add a splash of water and cover briefly if needed.

name: Pointed Gourd Mustard Curry (Potol Shorshe)
instructions: Soak mustard seeds briefly, then grind with green chilli and a little water.
Lightly fry pointed gourds with turmeric and salt.
Add mustard paste and water; simmer gently until the gourds are tender. Finish with mustard oil.

name: Pointed Gourd Poppy Seed Curry (Potol Posto)
instructions: Soak and grind poppy seeds with green chilli into a smooth paste.
Heat oil, add nigella seeds and pointed gourd; sauté with salt.
Add poppy-seed paste and a little water. Cover and cook until tender and the gravy thickens.

name: Crispy Pointed Gourd Fry
instructions: Slice the pointed gourds thinly and pat dry.
Toss with rice flour, turmeric, chilli powder and salt.
Shallow-fry in batches until crisp and golden; drain and serve.

name: Pointed Gourd Besan Fry
instructions: Mix besan, rice flour, spices and salt with enough water to make a thick coating.
Dip pointed-gourd slices in the batter.
Shallow-fry or deep-fry until crisp and cooked through.

name: Pointed Gourd Onion Stir-Fry
instructions: Heat mustard oil and add nigella seeds and green chilli.
Add onion and cook until softened. Add pointed gourd, turmeric and salt.
Stir-fry until tender with lightly browned edges; serve hot.

name: Pointed Gourd Tomato Curry
instructions: Lightly fry pointed-gourd pieces and set aside.
In the same pan, fry cumin seeds, ginger and tomato until soft.
Add spices and pointed gourd with a little water; cover and simmer until tender.
